name: weft
description: Weft — a local-first, self-hostable Notion clone. A woven web of connected notes.

scripts.dev: node scripts/setup.mjs && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @weft/server dev" "pnpm --filter @weft/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @weft/shared build && pnpm --filter @weft/server build && pnpm --filter @weft/web build
